title: Measure MCU costs of the approved experiment
description:
Measure the complete approved MCU/driver workload, including signing, verification, peer search, IRQ/SPI, retuning, acquisition, timeouts, FEC, memory and missed deadlines. Reuse rf.08 radio timing and existing lora_ipv6_mesh-shbh verification-cost evidence as starting points, not proof of production performance.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Require affirmative matching microfrag.06, authority.10 and rf.03 approvals before ports or RF. Approval covers only the named session, setup and waveform. Closed prerequisites, dev-mode measurements or prior sessions are not clearance; denial or mismatch leaves execution blocked or deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Calibrated timing and memory evidence on the exact build distinguish CPU work, radio occupancy and scheduled waits. Include malformed/injected fragments and maximum approved peer/block loads; measure energy where approved instrumentation exists. Reject unsupported hash-only cycle counts and universal idle-CPU claims.
